# Plan for Issue #3381: Fix Daily Super Run Failures on Staging

## Goal

Resolve the two job failures in daily super run `42379404709` on `staging` (commit `9ce6dbc`):

1. **`e2e component (chrome)` failure**:
   - Commit `9ce6dbc` (#3341) added [card-sizes.cy.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/cypress/component/card-sizes.cy.tsx#L184-L186), which calls [`writeSettings({ hoverPreviews: false })`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L131).
   - In Cypress component testing, test isolation is not enabled across specs within the browser session (`testIsolation: false`).
   - The test's `afterEach` hook calls [`__resetSettingsForTests()`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L182-L185), which only resets the in-memory cache `snapshot = null` and removes `data-reduce-motion`. It preserves `localStorage`, leaving `{"hoverPreviews": false}` in storage.
   - Subsequent component specs (e.g., `meditative-prompts.cy.tsx`) load `{ hoverPreviews: false }` from `localStorage`.
   - In `meditative-prompts.cy.tsx`, the `hold()` helper performs pointerdown and waits for `cy.get(ts(INSPECT_HOVER)).should("be.visible")`. Because `hoverPreviews` is `false`, [`useInspectTrigger`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/cards/inspect/useInspectTrigger.tsx#L180-L195) suppresses hover preview creation, causing the assertion to time out and fail the job.

2. **`e2e (4/8)` failure**:
   - Shard 4 of 8 runs specs `19-queue-modes-and-series`, `28-patch-011-ui`, `35-settings-dialog`, `39-replays`, `47-tap-areas`, and `48-tutorial-final-exam`.
   - Spec 39 ([39-replays.cy.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/cypress/e2e/39-replays.cy.ts#L41-L95)) runs right before Spec 47 ([47-tap-areas.cy.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts#L408-L412)), completing an online match with account `p2`.
   - In PR CI (smoke shard 2/2), Spec 39 never runs, so `p2` had 0 replays and `/replays` rendered only an empty state. But in shard 4/8, `p2` now has a completed online replay row rendered.
   - In [replays.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/routes/replays.css#L36-L39), `.replays__row > button { min-height: 40px; }` applies only to direct button children ([`DownloadJson`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/routes/replays.tsx#L120) and `Watch`).
   - The [`ShareWithFriend`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/together/ShareReplay.tsx#L80) component is wrapped in `<div className="share-friend"><button ...>`, which does not match `.replays__row > button` and receives no `min-height: 40px` style.
   - Furthermore, in [together.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/together/together.css#L414-L417), `.replays__row .share-friend` is styled with `align-items: flex-end`. On mobile (`max-width: 420px`), `.replays__row` switches to `flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch`. The direct buttons stretch full-width, while `.share-friend > button` remains aligned to the right at default height, causing hit area shortfall and neighbour collision violations under R2122000 in [`expectHitAreas()`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts#L165).

---

## Files to Touch

1. [card-sizes.cy.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/cypress/component/card-sizes.cy.tsx)
   - Import [`resetSettings`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L140) alongside `__resetSettingsForTests` and `writeSettings` from `../../../apps/web/src/settings/index.ts`.
   - Add [`resetSettings()`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L140) to the `afterEach` hook in `describe("#3341 a phone's inspect sheet draws a taller card")`.
2. [component.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/support/component.tsx)
   - Import [`resetSettings`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L140) and [`__resetSettingsForTests`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L182) from `../../apps/web/src/settings/index.ts`.
   - Add global `beforeEach` and `afterEach` hooks to guarantee all component specs execute and exit with default settings.
3. [replays.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/routes/replays.css)
   - Update line 36 so `.replays__row button` or `.replays__row > button, .replays__row .share-friend > button` both receive `flex: none; min-height: 40px;`.
   - In `@media (max-width: 420px)`, add `.replays__row .share-friend { align-items: stretch; }` so on mobile viewports the share control stretches uniformly with the `Download JSON` and `Watch` buttons.
4. [together.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/together/together.css)
   - Ensure `.replays__row .share-friend > button` sizing harmonizes with row actions across desktop and mobile breakpoints.

---

## Steps

### Step 1: Prevent Settings Leakage in Component Tests
1. In [card-sizes.cy.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/cypress/component/card-sizes.cy.tsx):
   - Update import from `../../../apps/web/src/settings/index.ts` to include `resetSettings`.
   - In `describe("#3341 a phone's inspect sheet draws a taller card")`'s `afterEach` hook:
     ```tsx
     afterEach(() => {
       resetSettings();
       __resetSettingsForTests();
     });
     ```
2. In [component.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/e2e/support/component.tsx):
   - Import `resetSettings, __resetSettingsForTests` from `../../apps/web/src/settings/index.ts`.
   - Register global hooks:
     ```tsx
     beforeEach(() => {
       resetSettings();
       __resetSettingsForTests();
     });

     afterEach(() => {
       resetSettings();
       __resetSettingsForTests();
     });
     ```

### Step 2: Fix Replay Row Button Hit Areas on Mobile
1. In [replays.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/routes/replays.css):
   - Change:
     ```css
     .replays__row > button {
       flex: none;
       min-height: 40px;
     }
     ```
     to:
     ```css
     .replays__row > button,
     .replays__row .share-friend > button {
       flex: none;
       min-height: 40px;
     }
     ```
   - In `@media (max-width: 420px)`:
     ```css
     @media (max-width: 420px) {
       .replays__row {
         flex-direction: column;
         align-items: stretch;
       }

       .replays__row .share-friend {
         align-items: stretch;
       }
     }
     ```
2. Verify [together.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/together/together.css):
   - Desktop rules (`.replays__row .share-friend { flex: none; align-items: flex-end; }`) remain intact above 420px width.

### Step 3: Run Verification Suite
1. Build WASM package:
   `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`
2. Run relevant Vitest test suites:
   `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/together/ShareReplay.test.tsx src/routes/replays.test.tsx src/test/ux/settings.test.tsx`
3. Run TypeScript typechecks:
   - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
   - `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck`
   - `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component`
4. Run project consistency checks:
   - `cargo fmt --check`
   - `cargo jackioh catalog check`
   - `cargo jackioh patches check`
   - `cargo jackioh spec check`

---

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/together/ShareReplay.test.tsx src/routes/replays.test.tsx`
  - Validates replay list rows, JSON downloads, replay loading, and friend-sharing behavior.

  - Validates settings store contracts, reset behavior, and persistence without regression.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/cardSizes.test.ts src/cards/fit.test.tsx src/cards/fullArtBoard.test.tsx`
  - Validates card sizing and responsive inspection from PR #3370.

  - Ensures clean compilation with zero TypeScript errors across web and e2e test sources.

  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo jackioh catalog check`

  - `cargo jackioh spec check`

---

## Done when

- `.replays__row` buttons, including `<ShareWithFriend>`, have `min-height: 40px` and stretch cleanly on phones (`max-width: 420px`) to satisfy R2122000 tap area constraints.
- All web unit tests, typechecks, and harness checks pass cleanly.

---

## Risks

- **Breaking `store.ts` reload persistence tests**: In [settings.test.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/test/ux/settings.test.tsx#L196-L201), tests rely on `__resetSettingsForTests()` clearing only the in-memory cache to simulate a page reload while preserving `localStorage`.
  - *Mitigation*: Do not change the contract of [`__resetSettingsForTests()`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L182-L185) in [store.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts). Instead, call [`resetSettings()`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3381/apps/web/src/settings/store.ts#L140) in the test lifecycle hooks.
